# Theoria — Scene Systems

> Open-source TypeScript libraries for numerics, optimization, language-model programming, text layout, and cryptography, built with Effect.

## Packages

- @scenesystems/effect-math: Foundational numerics, linear algebra, statistics, and optimization for Effect
- @scenesystems/effect-search: Effect-native black-box optimization for TypeScript
- @scenesystems/effect-dsp: Effect-native DSPy — programming, not prompting, language models
- @scenesystems/effect-text: Effect-native text preparation, measurement, and greedy multiline layout
- @scenesystems/effect-inference: Effect-native provider-blind inference runtime descriptors and resolution
- @scenesystems/digest: Cryptographic content hashing and canonicalization for Effect
- @scenesystems/seal: Authenticated encryption for Effect
- @scenesystems/sign: Digital signatures, key agreement, and key encapsulation for Effect
